headline.caveat: >$500B combined target across all six financiers, subject to final agreements; no per-firm allocation disclosed

nature_md: Blackstone is one of six financiers in NVIDIA's Aug 10, 2026 coalition to establish AI-compute-infrastructure financing platforms mobilizing >$500B of third-party capital via SPVs whose debt is collateralized by NVIDIA compute. Blackstone already owns QTS (its largest portfolio company, ~10GW+ data-center pipeline) and AirTrunk, making it both landlord and prospective lender to the AI buildout. Per-firm commitments undisclosed; agreements are MOUs.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Prospective client-capital deployment (private credit, infrastructure, insurance channels) — fee-earning AUM, not Blackstone Inc. principal; nothing booked at MOU stage.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Target capitalization for platforms not yet funded; >$500B is aspirational pending final agreements.
